I’ve always had this one stubborn belief:

If a blockchain is ever going to matter globally, it should be strong enough to run the daily transactions of an entire nation, without lag, without drama, without breaking a sweat.

Crazy goal, right?

But that’s exactly the challenge I decided to chase at @VenomFoundation.

My vision is simple:

Build a Layer 1 so steady, so secure, and so ridiculously fast that even at peak national activity, every user still gets instant, predictable confirmations. No chaos. No slowdown. Just smooth performance, every single time.

To make that real, Venom was built with something I’m especially proud of:
dynamic, intelligent sharding.

Think of it like a living system.

When the network suddenly gets flooded with activity, it automatically splits itself into more shards to handle the pressure. And when things get quieter, it merges back. keeping everything efficient. 

The result?

A chain that stays consistently responsive while giving builders room to launch as many projects as they want, without ever worrying about congestion.

And honestly? The vibe in the Venom ecosystem right now feels electric.
Every day I’m watching new developers, creators, and users plug in and push things forward.

Here’s a glimpse of what I’m excited about:

▫️ Venom Quests has already funneled millions of dollars in tokens straight into the hands of the community.
Season 5 just rolled out, and I’m dropping another 11 million $VENOM to reward everyone exploring our DeFi, NFTs, and the many apps already running on the chain.

▫️ On the government side, we’ve kicked off a massive national digital transformation initiative with the Government of the Philippines, and it’s not just an announcement. It’s live. It’s active. And it’s moving fast.

I’ve also got an ongoing campaign with @BingXOfficial, and it’s been a fun one to watch grow.

🤝 If you’re new to BingX and want to jump in, here’s my invite link: https://t.co/L85SD665pZ
And when you’re posting your campaign tweets, feel free to plug in my referral code too:
Ref: EbubechukwuNick 

#BingXSpotBlast

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 24 November 2025(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Sariaya, Lucena, Tayabas, Lucban, Mauban, Sampaloc, Pagbilao, Atimonan, Agdangan, Padre Burgos, Unisan, Plaridel, Pitogo, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag, Buenavista, San Narciso, San Andres, San Francisco, Mulanay, Catanauan, General Luna).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, Cavite, Tarlac, Zambales and Bataan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Laguna, Metro Manila, Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Tiaong, General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Burdeos, Jomalig, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Polillo) and Batangas(Talisay, Tanauan, Santo Tomas, Malvar, Lipa, Padre Garcia, San Juan, Rosario, Taysan, Lobo, Batangas City, Ibaan, San Jose, Cuenca, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, San Pascual, Alitagtag, Santa Teresita, San Nicolas, Taal, San Luis, Bauan, Mabini, Agoncillo, Laurel, Lemery, Calaca) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
